```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

source("functions.R")

simSettings = read_parquet("data/simSettings.parquet")
resultsNormalApprox = readRDS("data/resultsNormalApprox.rds")
resultsAssurance = read_parquet("data/resultsAssurance.parquet")
resultsFreq = read_parquet("data/resultsFreq.parquet")

## Target power thresholds (match the simulation setup)
powerTargets = c(0.8, 0.9)

## One row per risk difference scenario
scenarios = simSettings |>
    distinct(pCon, pInt, riskDiff, OR, nTrialSizeCap)

## Bayesian Power curve: proportion of simulated trials declaring benefit
bayesCurve = resultsNormalApprox |>
    group_by(pInt, cv, nTrialSize) |>
    summarise(
        power = mean(success, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

## Frequentist Assurance curve: closed-form power averaged over the design prior
assuranceCurve = resultsAssurance |>
    select(pInt, cv, nTrialSize, power = assurancePower)
```

```{r}
## Function to calculate a single scenariors power for a given n and CV
summariseCurve = function(curve, checkpoints) {
    ## Power at each checkpoint: one row per cv + checkpoint combo
    checkpointPower = curve |>
        expand_grid(checkpoint = checkpoints) |>
        group_by(cv, checkpoint) |>
        slice_min(abs(nTrialSize - checkpoint), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
        ungroup() |>
        pivot_wider(
            id_cols = cv,
            names_from = checkpoint,
            values_from = power,
            names_prefix = "powerAt_"
        )

    ## Interpolated total sample size at each target power
    targetN = curve |>
        nest(powerCurve = c(nTrialSize, power)) |>
        expand_grid(powerTarget = powerTargets) |>
        rowwise() |>
        mutate(nForTarget = interp_n_for_power(powerCurve, powerTarget)) |>
        ungroup() |>
        pivot_wider(
            id_cols = cv,
            names_from = powerTarget,
            values_from = nForTarget,
            names_prefix = "nFor_"
        )

    checkpointPower |>
        left_join(targetN, by = join_by(cv)) |>
        mutate(
            # p-infinity = power ceiling
            pInfinity = pnorm(1 / cv),
            .after = cv
        )
}

## Format for printing: powers as proportions, N values as comma-separated, NA (target power never reached within the trial sample size) as "-"
formatPower = function(power) {
    sprintf("%.3f", power)
}

formatN = function(n) {
    if_else(is.na(n), "-", scales::comma(round(n)))
}

## Explanatory footer printed under each table
tableFootnote = "*\"-\": the target power was not reached within the simulated trial sizes.*\n\n"

## Word page break
pageBreak = "```{=openxml}\n<w:p><w:r><w:br w:type=\"page\"/></w:r></w:p>\n```\n\n"

formatSummary = function(summary, checkpoints) {
    summary |>
        mutate(
            across(starts_with("powerAt_"), formatPower),
            across(starts_with("nFor_"), formatN),
            pInfinity = sprintf("%.2f", pInfinity)
        ) |>
        set_names(c(
            "CV",
            "p∞",
            paste0("Power at n = ", scales::comma(checkpoints)),
            paste0("N for ", scales::percent(powerTargets), " power")
        ))
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis

# Make all the tables
for (i in seq_len(nrow(scenarios))) {
    scenario = scenarios[i, ]

    ## Trim each curve to the scenario's simulated range
    bayes = bayesCurve |>
        filter(pInt == scenario$pInt, nTrialSize <= scenario$nTrialSizeCap)
    assurance = assuranceCurve |>
        filter(pInt == scenario$pInt, nTrialSize <= scenario$nTrialSizeCap)
    freq = resultsFreq |>
        filter(pInt == scenario$pInt, nTrialSize <= scenario$nTrialSizeCap) |>
        rename(power = freqPower)

    ## N checkpoints spread across the simulated range, as in the reference
    checkpoints = unique(quantile(
        unique(bayes$nTrialSize),
        probs = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0),
        type = 1
    ))

    cat(sprintf("## RD = %.2f (OR = %.2f)\n\n", -scenario$riskDiff, scenario$OR))

    ## Conventional frequentist reference at the assumed (fixed) effect size
    freqN = tibble(powerTarget = powerTargets) |>
        rowwise() |>
        mutate(nForTarget = interp_n_for_power(freq, powerTarget)) |>
        ungroup()

    cat(sprintf(
        "Conventional frequentist (α=0.025, one-sided, assumed effect size): %s.\n\n",
        paste(
            sprintf(
                "N for %s power = %s",
                scales::percent(freqN$powerTarget),
                formatN(freqN$nForTarget)
            ),
            collapse = "  |  "
        )
    ))

    print(knitr::kable(
        summariseCurve(bayes, checkpoints) |> formatSummary(checkpoints),
        caption = sprintf("Bayesian Power, RD = %.2f", -scenario$riskDiff),
        align = "r"
    ))
    cat("\n\n", tableFootnote, pageBreak)

    print(knitr::kable(
        summariseCurve(assurance, checkpoints) |> formatSummary(checkpoints),
        caption = sprintf("Frequentist Assurance, RD = %.2f", -scenario$riskDiff),
        align = "r"
    ))
    cat("\n\n", tableFootnote)

    ## Page break after each table, except the very last (avoids a blank trailing page)
    if (i < nrow(scenarios)) {
        cat(pageBreak)
    }
}
```
